verdict.rationale: Loops documents a public API (with an OpenAPI spec) that can create and manage campaigns and their content, including draft campaigns authored via the Content API/LMX. However, its own docs say the flow is "Review and send from the dashboard," so sending or scheduling still happens in the UI rather than entirely through the API. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint to schedule or send a campaign/broadcast, a fully dashboard-free end-to-end flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
